title: What was falsified, and what was not

falsified.claim: template membership <=> ord(eps(d)) even  (an empirical fit of mine)
falsified.verdict: REFUTED at m=6: 468 of 3888 keys admit a schedule with ord(eps(d)) odd
falsified.note: I had verified this only for m=2,3,4 and then asserted it for m=5,6 without running the check. That was my error.

not_falsified.claim: a twisted depth-6 schedule requires |M| even, M = <alpha_s - alpha_s', beta_t - beta_t'> <= Z_m
not_falsified.verdict: HOLDS on every enumerated key of m=2,3,4,5,6 (7920 keys, 0 violations)
not_falsified.note: My apparent counterexample h4_Z36_C1_0 used M = <eps(d)>, a smaller subgroup, not the subgroup generated by all six label differences. Recomputed correctly, |M| is even at every m where that instance admits a schedule (m=6,12,18 -> |M|=6,12,18).

m6_reconciliation.comment: both eps(d)!=0 and |M| even are necessary; together they are not sufficient, the true condition is narrower by 28 keys per pattern
